type Universal<T> = T extends unknown ? number : never;
type WithAny<T> = T extends any ? number : never;
type Related<T> = T extends unknown ? T : never;
type Disjoint<T> = T extends string ? 5 : 6;
function wrongUniversal<T>(): Universal<T> { return "wrong"; }
function wrongAny<T>(): WithAny<T> { return "wrong"; }
function wrongDependent<T>(): Related<T> { return "wrong"; }
function wrongBranch<T>(): Disjoint<T> { return 5; }
const neverUnknown: Universal<never> = 3;
const neverAny: WithAny<never> = 3;
